The appeal and the cross objections arise from the judgment and award, dated 15.04.2021, passed in M.V.C. No.1530/2018 by the Additional Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Belagavi, (for short, 'the Tribunal').

entities.text: Additional Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Belagavi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: In terms of the impugned judgment and award, the Tribunal has awarded a sum of Rs.9,55,000/- along with interest at the rate of 6% per annum from the date of petition till the date of payment.
The liability on the insurance company is absolved by the Tribunal.
2. The owner of the vehicle has filed the appeal in M.F.A. No.101722/2021 and the claimants have filed the cross-objections in M.F.A. Cross Obj. No.100113/2022.
3. Appellant and respondent Nos.1(a) & 1(b) in M.F.A. No.101722/2021 are present.
They have filed a compromise petition.

4. In terms of the compromise petition, the appellant/owner of the vehicle has agreed to pay and the legal representatives of the deceased claimant/respondent No.1 have agreed to receive Rs.7,75,000/-
towards full and final settlement of their claim.
The mode of payment is mentioned in paragraph No.4.b. of the compromise petition.
A sum of Rs.5,00,000/- is already deposited before this Court and it is stated that the legal representatives of the deceased claimant/respondent No.1 are entitled to the said amount.
The balance amount of Rs.2,75,000/- is stated to be paid to the legal representatives of the deceased claimant i.e., respondent Nos.1(a) & 1(b) and the same is admitted by them.

5. Under the circumstances, this Court is of the view that the impugned judgment and award of the Tribunal are modified in terms of the above, and accordingly, the appeal and the cross-objections stand disposed of in terms of the compromise petition.
Registry to apportion the amount in deposit equally between respondents No.1(a) & 1(b).
The amount in deposit before this Court be released in favour of respondents No.1(a) & 1(b).
